review_description: From the quote with David to booking with Charmain, andnstallation with Cooper and Dan everything was handledpromptly and professionally.I highly recommend Solahart they have been around for 70 yearsand are reliable and when you spend this kind of money that'swhat you want. Thanks

The sales process was great, came and quoted within a week. Maybe a little bit pushy, but when I was unsure of something they supplied the information, and they went above and beyond to share their knowledge.  Also, when I was unhappy with a particular aspect, they fixed it immediately, no argument.Solahart had contractors install the system. They came weeks ahead of schedule when there was an unexpected sunny day. They were awesome, polite, respectful, efficient, even tidied up after themselves.Customer service was good except the communication between all parties could have been better.When I pushed to have them come out to turn the system on and set up my app after my energy provider upgraded by smart meter (instead of following the instructions I received in an email), they complied the very same day of my request.I had my solar up and running within weeks of getting the ball rolling. Outstanding!

salesperson / consultant from Solahart explained everything about solar from start to finish and why. the others went the hard sell and ‘just get the biggest’ set up.Solahart kept us informed leading up to installation  & conducted a site inspection to answer my questions about install details.the Electricians that did the install were the best..!punctual, and firstly explaining what their plan was, to neat and tidy work (our home had some challenging cable routing) and even post-install info explaining everything. nothing was an issue. absolute professionals.very happy we went with Solahart.
Great installation crew who worked safely and efficiently under difficult conditions (wind).

I chose Solahart because they seemed to have good reviews and recommendations. I thought the Solahart hot water system would go well with the 10 kW solar system as my property does not have room for a heat pump hot water tank.I had talked with the salesman about my long term plan to get an EV and 2 way charger for V2H and I assumed the system he sold me would work for that.I have had several issues with this company and their products and installation:-1 poor communication with keeping me informed about when and who. I thought the salesperson would be my contact through the installation process but there was confusing email messages and no handover nor clear advice about dates.2  I find out 5 months after installation that the Goodwe inverter installed is not compatible with a battery at all.3 I paid for a consumption monitor but they forgot about it during installation and took 3 months to get one and put it in.4 the routing for the hot water is too long and done the easiest way not the best way. It takes a full 2 minutes and 20 litres of water to get hot water at the kitchen tap.5 the Solahart hot water system I was told by the salesman would only require minimal electric boost and only in winter. The consumption meter tells me that it uses up to 8kWh a day on cloudy days even in spring and still uses some electric boost on sunny days. It seems that it needed to be installed with a more optimal northerly aspect.Although the company has begun discussing these issues with me, I cannot recommend this company.
Informative, listened to my requirements, answered all my questions, great installers

The sales representative from Solahart Illawarra attended in person and walked us through the process with exact costing and printouts of potential savings. It was his presentation that sold us the product.
Installers flexible , competent and seemed informed . Very easy to interact with.

The system initially quoted could not be installed due to the nature of the house. Whilst this was disappointing, Natacha and the team at Solahart Wollongong have been nothing but friendly and helpful and were able to offer a suitable alternate solution. The installation team were very professional, and the work was carried out to a high standard. I have no issues recommending them to anyone looking for a solar system in the Wollongong region.

The Sales and quoting process was excellent and efficient.  The installers were punctual and very quick.My only gripe is that I would have liked more proactive communication about when the install changed dates.  Weather meant that install dates had shifted, but I had to call them to confirm, rather than being contacted pro-actively.  It's a small thing, but given that I wanted to be home when the install took place, I had to schedule work activities around the install.  Pro active comms is literally the only thing stopping a full 5 stars across the board.

Customer service was good although had one issue where they had supplied an inferior panel that was quoted. The only way I noticed was the fact that it rained so they stored the panels in my garage until the weather cleared up and when I checked the manufacture sticker I realised if was the wrong panels. If they installed it that day there would be no way of knowing they installed a cheaper product. When I let them know they did switch out the panels to the ones on the quote. Installers were very polite and did a good job from what I can tell.
Solhart have been helpful as per reviews and recommendations. System installed and working away happily despite the constant rain! Grateful for advice and after sales support

Nat and the team at Solahart Wollongong have been so helpful throughout each step during our solar installation. They go above and beyond to make sure the customer is informed and are getting the products they want. Special thank you to Nat, I gave her a difficult time because I was a specific with what I wanted, but she produced the goods and communicated with me every step of the way. The boys who installed were extremely professional and tidy. I could see that they took pride in their workmanship.
